params.command: $candidates=@((Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods'),(Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'agent-control-panel')); foreach($p in $candidates){ if(Test-Path (Join-Path $p '.git')){ Write-Output ('REPO='+$p); Set-Location $p; git fetch --prune origin; Write-Output ('HEAD='+(git rev-parse HEAD)); Write-Output ('BRANCH='+(git branch --show-current)); Write-Output ('ORIGIN_MAIN='+(git rev-parse origin/main)); Write-Output 'STATUS:'; git status --short; Write-Output 'WORKTREES:'; git worktree list --porcelain; break } }
